text: ﻿function GetElectionYears(electionType) { $('#ElectionYear').empty(); $.ajax({ url: '/Candidate/GetYearsByElectionType?electionType=' + electionType, success: function (data) { $('#ElectionYear').append(' '); $.each(data, function (key, value) { $('#ElectionYear').append(' ' + value.electionYear + ' '); }) }, error: function (error) { alert("Error loading data"); } }); } function GetElections(electionType, electionYear) { $('#ElectionID_list').empty(); $.ajax({ url: '/Candidate/GetElections?electionType=' + electionType + '&year=' + electionYear, success: function (data) { $.each(data, function (key, value) { $('#ElectionID_list').append(` ${value.displayName} `); }) }, error: function (error) { alert("Error loading data"); } }); } function clearSession() { // Clear session from candidate search (default/date) & referendum search (default/date) var sessionStorageKeys = [ "countyList", "electionList", "SelectedOffice", "SelectedAssociatedCounty", "SelectedCandidateStatus", "CandidateFirstName", "CandidateLastName", "SelectedPoliticalParty", "SelectedFilingLocation", "gridCandidateSearch", "ElectionDate", "SelectedResponsibleCounty", "SelectedGroup", "gridReferendumSearch", "referendumcountyList", "referendumelectionList", "referendumSelectedResponsibleCounty", "referendumSelectedGroup", "referendumgridReferendumSearch", ]; sessionStorageKeys.forEach(key => { sessionStorage.removeItem(key); }); } function clearValidation() { var validationElement = $('.validation'); validationElement.addClass('validation-summary-valid').removeClass('validation-summary-errors'); } $(document).ready(function () { clearSession(); $('#ElectionKindSid').on("change", function () { if ($('#ElectionKindSid').val() != "") { GetElectionYears($('#ElectionKindSid').val()); } else { $('#ElectionYear').empty(); $('#ElectionID_list').empty(); } }); $('#ElectionYear').on("change", function () { if ($('#ElectionYear').val() != "") { GetElections($('#ElectionKindSid').val(), $('#ElectionYear').val()); } else { $('#ElectionID_list').empty(); } }); $('.submit-election').click(function () { var valid = $('#SelectElectionForm').valid(); if (valid) { iForms.ShowSearchMessage(true); } else { $('#CandidateMessage').focus(); return false; } }); $('#ElectionDate').on("keyup change", function () { clearValidation(); }); }); $(window).on('unload', function () { if ($('#ElectionKindSid').length) { $('#ElectionKindSid').val("") }; });
